description: Read-only. Report how current Utilify's Texas utility plan data is, per utility type (electricity, gas, water, trash, internet, other). Returns aggregate counts and dates only: active plans, active providers, newest and oldest last-verified dates, the share of active plans inside and outside the staleness targets (electricity: stale after 7 days, expired after 30; other types: stale after 90 days, expired after 365), active plans past their valid-until date, and active plans by data origin (legacy, provider_submitted, provider_site, public_agency). Statewide results also include the number of competitive-market electricity ZIPs with zero active plans. Pass `zip` for the same figures limited to plans listed for one ZIP. Use this before relying on prices from other tools when recency matters. It does not return plans, prices, provider names, links or contact details, and it changes nothing.

utility_type.description: Limit the result to one utility type

zip.description: Optional 5-digit ZIP code; when given, figures cover only plans listed for that ZIP

name: get_data_freshness
